You still share a few mutual friends and some practical loose ends. You know each other's routines, habits, and the way each of you handles stress.

private_lines.Inès: You live with a flatmate in Villeurbanne and work as a nurse on rotating shifts at the Hôpital de la Croix-Rousse. Your days vary with your rota, and you often sleep during the day after night shifts.

text: Are you still holding the spare keys to the Croix-Rousse flat? The landlord wants them back before the handover on Friday.
hey. i think they're in the little dish by the door? or in my green bag from before. not sure 😅 i'm on nights from tonight so can't go look till i'm home
Nights till when?
Sorry, that's not important. If they're in the bag, can you check when you're up? The landlord's agent was clear that every set has to come back, including the one for the cellar.
on till 7 tmrw. will look when i get back. dont worry about the cellar one i think it was never copied
It was. Matthieu had one made in 2023 for the bins. Check the dish first.
If you find them, drop them at my place or I can meet you near Hôtel de Ville on Thursday lunch. Either works for me.
Thanks for checking. Is the cellar key on the ring too, or only the two for the flat?
home. found them in the green bag like i said. there's a third key on the ring that doesn't look like the flat ones, could be cellar? sorry was half asleep when i got in
i'll bring them thurs. or leave them w the concierge if i'm running late
The concierge is fine if you need to, but I'd rather hand them over myself so the agent can count them there. Lunch at 12:30 still works?
Did you see my last message?
yes sorry was asleep. 12:30 is fine. the third one is labelled cave in marker so yeah
Good. I'll bring the inventory sheet too. The agent wants each set listed with a signature, so you'll need to sign at the lunch.
ok
Does the signature need to be your full name or just initials?
on shift, cant really talk. full name i think. check the form
The form says full name, printed and signed, plus the date. I checked it this morning.
ok. home now. sleeping till 2 probably
The agent rang. Can we do 13:00 on Thursday instead of 12:30? Their 14:00 slot got moved up and they'd rather finish the inventory before it.
just woke up. 13 is fine, i'll be there
Good. I'll tell the agent. Bring the ring with all three, including the cave one.
yes
rough one last night. one of the older men on my ward didn't make it, his daughter was there
sorry. you don't need to reply to that
That's hard. Are you sleeping or are you on again tonight?
off till friday. trying to sleep but it's not really working
Eat something before you lie down, even if it's just bread.
ok. 13h. have the keys
